description: End-to-end scenario runner for three canonical flows: (1) new MCP submission → signal scored → verdict assigned → attestation generated → UI visible, (2) threat intel overlay → risk register updated, (3) analyst override → verdict changed → attestation revoked. e2e_scenarios.py is quarantined (3 consecutive fails in cohort_7_n4); propose runner as distinct file. MUST: (1) create synthetic MCP test entries in mcp_submissions, (2) trigger signal_analyser, (3) verify trust_synthesiser writes verdict to mcp_server_registry, (4) verify attestation_engine produces attestation, (5) verify search_api returns result. MUST NOT: use live production MCPs; use isolated synthetic data. Reads: e2e_scenarios.py (for flow definition patterns). This is the TEST for e2e_scenarios.py integration, not the spec itself.
